acknowledged.prop:published-class-inclusion: This delivered proposition fixes the paper's link to the published admissible-design and outcome-law classes, records the proper Gaussian subclass, and supplies the benchmark special cases used to interpret the main capacity theorem; it belongs as a standalone literature-to-formal-model bridge.
acknowledged.thm:capacity-answer: This is the paper's delivered capstone theorem: it states the complete construction, minimax rate, legal prior, HT-excess transfer, and dimension frontier in one reader-facing result, so it remains even though later proof environments cite its component theorems rather than the capstone itself.
